discovery: stop while ongoing; retry/recheck when ended
candidate: candidate latest chapter or explicit unknown
search request latency or local pending/failure state

dynamicDesignConstraints: Candidate identity uses sourceId and bookUrl in implementation; illustration uses unique fictional sources.
New candidates append, existing metadata updates in place; touch/scroll delay reordering.
Reserved metadata/status slots and consistent row height within each layout.
Rechecking preserves candidates and chapter data; unknown metrics have no numeric fabrication.
Search latency indicates search request duration, not body reading speed, quality or proven readability.
Drawer height remains fixed; longer candidates use internal scroll region.
Selected option still needs stopped, rechecking, switching, error/empty and long-text refinements.
staticImageLimitations: Image 1 omits an explicit latest-chapter label in book summary and redundantly prefixes unknown candidate chapters with Latest; refine if selected.
Image 1 current-source name glyph is generated imperfectly; implementation must use exact 青溪书阁 data.
Generated covers vary between alternatives; selected direction must reuse one actual cover asset.
Actual interaction, incremental updates, sorting anchors, long texts, accessibility, other themes/viewports, native and device behavior have not been tested by these mockups.
supersededReason: Human corrected rule: selectable candidates require successful source checks.
